schema.title: Response List Responses Api Projects  Project Id  Responses Get

post.description:
Trigger the multi-agent alignment workflow (Perspective -> Conflict -> Resolution).

Coordinates:
- Agent 1: Extracts structured goals, priorities, responsibilities, and deadlines.
- Agent 2: Identifies contradictory dates, priority mismatches, and information gaps.
- Agent 3: Proposes actionable compromises, leaving decisions strictly for human approval.

get.description: Retrieve the latest alignment synthesis report for a project.

post.description:
Approve, reject, or modify an AI-proposed resolution into an official project commitment.

Only human-approved actions transition an AI proposal into an official project commitment.
Validates that the resolution_id exists in the project's latest analysis report.

get.description: Retrieve all confirmed human decisions and project commitments.
